text.zh-TW: 1 點 = $1，下次付款即可折抵；取自平台分享文案，實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: 1 point = NT$1, redeemable on your next payment. Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟下載連結，並安裝全支付 App。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the download link and install the PX Pay Plus app.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊全支付會員，並在推薦碼欄位輸入 0ESI322L（連結通常會自動帶入）。
steps.en: Register as a member and enter 0ESI322L in the referral code field (the link usually fills it in).

steps.zh-TW: 完成首筆消費後，依活動規則取得全點，下次付款即可折抵。
steps.en: After your first purchase you receive the points under the campaign rules and can use them on your next payment.

intro.zh-TW: 全支付好友推薦：註冊會員並輸入推薦碼，可享首筆消費回饋。
intro.en: PX Pay Plus referral: register and enter the referral code to get a reward on your first purchase.

description.zh-TW:
全支付（PX Pay Plus）是需要安裝 App 才能註冊的支付服務。本站的好友推薦連結已附上推薦碼 0ESI322L，註冊頁通常會自動帶入；若欄位是空的，請自行輸入。

依平台分享文案，首筆消費可獲贈 50 全點（1 點 = $1，下次付款可折抵），實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。註冊時請核對推薦碼欄位與本頁顯示的是否相同。
description.en:
PX Pay Plus (全支付) is a payment service that you sign up for through its app. The friend referral link on this page already carries referral code 0ESI322L, so the sign-up page usually fills it in; if the field is empty, type the code in yourself.

According to the platform's share text, your first purchase can earn 50 points (1 point = NT$1, usable on your next payment). Actual terms and deadlines follow the official announcements, so when you register, check that the referral code field matches the one shown on this page.
